profile.headline: Software Application Engineer at Red Hat

positions.title: Investment Banking Application Support Analyist
positions.description:
· Provide level one and two support for internal and external business applications in a mixed environment
· Subject matter expert for mission critical trading and reporting application used by institutional and prime brokerage clients
· Subject matter expert for internal CRM system used across the investment banking business
· Work with testing, development and other level three teams in supporting and resolving user experienced bugs and feature requests   
· Create and maintain solutions for querying analytical data on users of the banks research and analytics applications

positions.title: Engineering Support Analyst
positions.description:
·     Assist the tens of thousands of Cisco employees and vendors worldwide supporting their primary work assets
·     Communicate with higher tier teams to assist in the maintenance of Cisco's technical infrastructure.
·     Record problems using ticket tracking software to insure proper handling of all reported problems.
·     Provide support for Internal Linux and Unix workstations, user applications, and development environment, including X11, printing, and accessing remote storage 
·     Provide junior-level system administration and support for Cisco’s Engineering Linux and Unix Servers and systems.
·     Support Cisco engineers with Propitiatory and Vendor-provided tools used for development and testing
·     Subject Matter Expert and primary level two support for Cisco’s SCM solution, including Rational ClearCase, Subversion, Rational Team Concert, and Git.
·     Work with level three application team on creating and maintaining user training materials, and assist team in incident trend reduction of common issues.
·     Level two support of Cisco’s internal Enterprise Messaging System, including core mail routing, mailbox setup and troubleshooting, and support of internal Mailing list and aliasing systems.

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description:
·     Provide technical support to clients worldwide.
·     Communicate with administration and other employees in order to develop and implement problem solution documentation.
·     Support hundreds of custom applications in order to allow customers access to the programs they needed to get their work done.

positions.title: ITS Student Consultant
positions.description:
·       Provide face-to-face technical support to UNC students, faculty, and staff. 
·       Communicate with administration and other employees in order to develop and implement reliable solutions for common problems. 
·       Record problems using ticket tracking software to insure proper handling of all reported problems.

positions.title: ITS Lab Attendant
positions.description:
·       Monitor and advise users to better help them use the lab facilities. 
·       Assist users with installed software and hardware.
